evidence.notes: Semantic, hand-authored CSS class names (e.g. 'v2-sec', 'home-h2', 'v2-btn primary', 'site-nav-inner') with no utility-class or CSS-module hashing indicate plain CSS. Consistent typographic system: Playfair Display serif for all headings (h1 44px, h2 34px, both weight 500) and Poppins for body (16px/400, rgb(85,85,85)). Primary brand text color rgb(35,40,58); gold accent rgb(200,169,110)/rgb(143,106,56). Two template families observed: homepage 'home-section' and interior 'v2-sec'. Accordion, table, and list component wrapper classes were frequently empty in the extracted data, so inner structural classes could not be confirmed. No responsive breakpoint data was present in the input.
